root_source: explicit protected per-VM root via QCryptoSecret; no generated fallback
primitive: SP800-108 counter-mode HMAC-SHA256, r=32, L=256, one block
uid_transform: AES256-CBC initial zero IV; re-encrypt same32 while carrying CBC IV across calls
uid_count: 0 normalizes to1; maximum65536, larger counts rejected
publication: same-context derived pair plus KEY roles4 and5; role6 validates only
reset: erase both staged and derived banks and retire epoch; preserve protected VM root for re-derivation
migration: must remain blocked by owning virtual profile until an encrypted migration contract exists
